scope: Read-only source, literature and archived-run review. Only this unique diagnostic file is written. No production, configuration, asset, current-run output, trajectory, solver or gate is modified; no native simulation is launched.

references.title: Low Stress Mechanical Properties of Plasma-Treated Cotton Fabric Subjected to Zinc Oxide-Anti-Microbial Treatment

sample.label: Control
sample.description: Semi-bleached plain woven cotton; control prior to the plasma/antimicrobial treatments compared in this experiment

references.G_definition: Average slope of the linear portions of the measured shear hysteresis curve through +/-2.5 degrees. Lower G indicates greater ease of shear and softer drape.
references.supports: A measured plain cotton combines approximately 10 micronewton-metre bending rigidity with an equivalent small-angle shear-energy coefficient of order 10^2 N/m rather than 500 N/m.
references.limits: Its density, weave, conditioning, anisotropy, hysteresis, tension during measurement and thickness under load differ from the simulation. No direct same-sample calibration or friction transfer to robot/plush/table is established.

references.title: Comfort and Handle Behaviour of Linen-Blended Fabrics
references.author: B.K. Behera
locations: Tables 1 and 3: areal mass and thickness
references.shear_unit_caveat: The printed Table 2 label gf cm/degree is ambiguous. The numerical comparison interprets G using the conventional KES force-per-width-per-degree definition explicitly given by Kan & Lam Table 2. It is an order-of-magnitude cross-check, not an exact material fit.
references.interpretation: These examples are softer in low-angle shear than the 175 gsm cotton control. The 185 gsm linen / 19.1229675 micronewton-metre bending pair is measured, but substituting it would choose a different, more resistant-to-bending fabric. It does not justify increasing D to prop the simulated opening.

references.title: KES-FB1-A Tensile and Shear Tester, manufacturer catalogue
references.relevance: Manufacturer distinguishes shear rigidity from shear hysteresis/recoverability, and documents finite tensile loading during shearing. Therefore a raw KES G value is not a direct fit of the simulation shear coefficient.

native_energy_source.formula: W = lambda * sum_i[(|F a_i|-1)^2 + q*max(|F a_i|-1,0)^3] + mu*(F a dot F b)^2
native_energy_source.native_area_weighting: Backend integrates W over rest triangle area; effective lambda and mu units are N/m. No extra thickness multiplier should be applied to the configured mu.

small_angle_derivation.stretch_contribution: O(gamma^4), with higher-order positive strain penalty
small_angle_derivation.caveat: This limiting calculation assumes the native orthogonal material chart and no pre-tension; it is not a KES experiment simulation or a finite-angle woven-fabric constitutive law.

body_shear_prior_assessment.conclusion: 50 N/m is an order-of-magnitude plausible compliant cotton prior and restores the accepted original body shear scale. 500 N/m was an unmeasured engineering increase to suppress diagonal principal deformation; it is not established as rag-like cotton/linen. High axial resistance and low shear resistance are independent goals.
not_claimed: 50 N/m is not a same-sample measurement or a uniquely correct cotton/linen coefficient.
Lower shear does not imply the lowest rim rises, opening improves, or the full task passes.
No inextensibility, physical damping, hysteresis or reduced rebound is established.

held_handle_assessment.retention_reason: Retained in full37 to isolate the body-only correction; it remains a separate unmeasured engineering value.
held_handle_assessment.limits: The 1000 N/m setting is not calibrated woven tape, sewn reinforcement or a measured bag handle. A later 500 N/m alternative would only be a more modest engineering increase from 250, not evidence of actual fabric properties. Do not schedule or assert it as a validated material.

full30_archived_deformation_evidence.sampling: Existing 1541 unique saved frames; integration-step edge metrics are a separate observable. No new native run or comparator was executed.
interpretation: Principal stretches are singular values of the in-surface deformation gradient and can increase under shear while the two construction directions remain nearly unchanged in length.

Full30 body principal extension peaks near 3.5%; construction-direction extension peaks are roughly 1–2%. Held front strap has 8.56875% maximum principal extension and 4.78384% maximum construction length extension, at potentially different faces.

Construction directions are geometric proxies, not measured yarn directions. Neither construction axes nor arbitrary native material chart axes establish physical warp/weft without an identified fabric orientation.
A high principal extension alone is not proof of rubber-like axial extension; shear, local contact loading and direction must be distinguished.

recorded_drape_evidence.interpretation: Full34 to full35 changed only D from4 to10 micronewton-metres; the lowest rim decreased by8.635072 mm. This observed path contradicts a simple monotonic increase of rim height with D. It does not prove a universal inverse relation.
recorded_drape_evidence.guard_scope: Both rejected at23.315s before insertion under the unchanged whole-bear-below-lowest-rim preflight. The test is an engineering admissibility condition, not a proof that actual cloth cannot contain the teddy.

friction_confound.full33_status: Intentionally interrupted at6.93s; no completed friction-only material/control comparison was established.
friction_confound.full32_to_full34: Both friction and bending changed, so their effects cannot be isolated by these two runs.
friction_confound.native_pair_rule: Geometric mean of the two material friction coefficients. Changing bag mu affects bag-self, bag-robot, bag-table and bag-teddy friction together; robot-teddy pair is unchanged.
friction_confound.restoring_original_0_65: A possible later independent contact control, not a proven correction and not part of the current body-only change. It may also increase resistance or jamming during insertion.
friction_confound.measurement_limit: KES MIU is measured against a standard contactor; values around0.2 in these papers must not be assigned directly to the simulation bag parameter or its robot/plush/table pairs.

current_trial_context.full36_interpretation: Intentionally interrupted; neither a completed 200gsm comparison nor a physical failure under a gate. The new trial must start from its own actual state and satisfy every original check.

completion_boundary: If physically supported compliant material still fails with the fixed geometry, accepted motion and unchanged acceptance conditions, report that this model/material/controller combination remains unverified. Do not manufacture success with excess bending stiffness, lower gravity, ideal pins, motion edits, weaker checks or unsupported damping.
